scout_tight_bidask_retrace.name: Scout Tight Bid-Ask Retrace
scout_tight_bidask_retrace.author: meridian-phase2a

token_criteria.notes: Scout-only tight-bin evidence strategy for high-fee, high-volume retrace or runner pools. Keep filters quality-biased; do not loosen screening to compensate for tighter bins.

entry.condition: Deploy SOL-only into a tight bid_ask range below active price after candidate passes current scout screening.
entry.notes: Use amount_y only, amount_x=0. The upper bin is pinned to active price with bins_above=0.

range.notes: Tight single-sided SOL range for the OOR-reposition scout trial. No volatility expansion unless a future strategy JSON explicitly defines it.

exit.notes: OOR-above may close and reposition only after fresh same-pool/base-mint screening passes. OOR-below is adverse/rug-risk and must not reposition.

scout_tight_bidask_retrace.best_for: Phase 2A scout evidence: tight bid_ask fee-density and OOR-above reposition behavior on higher-flow pools.
scout_tight_bidask_retrace.raw: Owner-approved scout tight-bin strategy-library profile; strategy-specific numbers live in JSON/config, not generic deploy code.

scout_fee_velocity_retrace_v1.name: Scout Fee-Velocity Retrace V1
scout_fee_velocity_retrace_v1.author: meridian-phase2a

token_criteria.notes: H2 conservative retrace profile for high flow per active TVL. Use direct Meteora validation and keep GMGN/Meteora source provenance in screening.

entry.condition: SOL-only bid_ask range below active price after candidate passes fee-velocity and existing scout screening gates.
entry.notes: Use amount_y only, amount_x=0, bins_above=0. H1/H3/H4/H5 comparisons stay in shadow metadata.

range.notes: Compute approximate bins from target_downside_pct and bin_step for screening/reporting; SDK range guards remain authoritative at execution time.

exit.notes: H2 midpoint TP. Shadow metadata compares 6/7/8 without changing runtime behavior.

shadow.notes: H1 sprint, H3 hybrid, H4 same-ticker surf, and H5 LP telemetry classifier are comparison-only until separately approved.

scout_fee_velocity_retrace_v1.best_for: Scout H2 fee-velocity retrace canary with SOL-only bid_ask and target downside range 12-20%.
scout_fee_velocity_retrace_v1.raw: Code-only strategy-library scaffold for fee-velocity retrace screening metadata; active strategy remains unchanged.
